\section{Discussion and Conclusion}
\label{sec:discussion}

STA exposes structural degeneration invisible to execution-based evaluation (\S\ref{sec:diagnostic}), and ISR exhibits Goodhart collapse at all four tested doses (trajectory-confirmed at $\beta{=}0.1$; \S\ref{sec:goodhart}--\ref{sec:crossscale}).
At 500 steps, ISR produces descriptively more non-hacking output than random controls (pooled N-H: 23\% vs.\ 8\%); seed-level permutation tests are consistent in direction but underpowered ($p{=}0.26$, $n{=}5$), and under stricter classification the effect reverses ($\text{OR}{=}0.61$, n.s.).
Extended training confirms the window closes.
ISR is reliable as a diagnostic but unreliable as an optimizer: the same LOO bias that rewards genuine necessity also rewards tautological constructions.
While Goodhart collapse under LOO-based metrics is theoretically predictable, specific phenomena resist prediction from the metric definition alone: stochastic bifurcation (\S\ref{sec:goodhart}), non-monotonic dose-response across four $\beta$ levels, and cross-logic mode divergence where Prolog exhibits gaming pathways absent from FOL (\S\ref{sec:crosslogic}).
These details underscore the gap between predicting \emph{that} a metric will be gamed and predicting \emph{how}.
ISR and similar perturbation-based metrics should serve as post-hoc evaluation tools, not training signals.

\paragraph{Scope.}
All experiments use a single model family (Qwen3-4B/1.7B), one dataset (FOLIO), and one RL algorithm (GRPO).
The specific hacking modes (H1, H7, H8) and their relative prevalence may differ under other architectures, training algorithms, or formal reasoning benchmarks; the structural vulnerability of LOO-based metrics to tautological exploits, however, follows from the metric definition and should transfer to any setting where the optimizer can reduce component count.

\paragraph{Implications for reward design.}
Our results illustrate a concrete instance of Goodhart's law in RL for formal reasoning: a metric designed to detect reward hacking becomes itself hackable when repurposed as an optimization target~\citep{manheim-goodhart-taxonomy}.
The failure mode is regressional rather than extremal: the optimizer does not find adversarial inputs that break the metric, but instead concentrates probability mass on regions where the metric's structural bias (favoring low component count) coincides with degenerate outputs.
For scalable oversight of solver-backed systems, this suggests that structural diagnostics should remain decoupled from the training loop.
Promising directions include ISR as a post-hoc filter (selecting high-ISR outputs without backpropagating through the metric), normalized variants that control for the premise-count confound, and hybrid rewards that combine execution feedback with semantic faithfulness signals independent of component-count structure.

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export PATH="/root/miniconda3/bin:$PATH"

PYTHON="/root/miniconda3/bin/python3"
CODE_DIR="/root/solver-trace-ablation"
OUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/outputs"
cd "$CODE_DIR"

run_one() {
    local CONDITION=$1
    local SEED=$2
    local CONFIG
    local REWARD_MODE
    local OUT_DIR

    if [ "$CONDITION" = "isr" ]; then
        CONFIG="configs/grpo_additive_bonus_b01.yaml"
        REWARD_MODE="additive_bonus"
        OUT_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/d134_4b_isr_b01_s${SEED}"
    else
        CONFIG="configs/grpo_additive_random_b01.yaml"
        REWARD_MODE="additive_random"
        OUT_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/d134_4b_random_b01_s${SEED}"
    fi

    echo "=========================================="
    echo "[$(date -u)] START ${CONDITION} b=0.1 seed=${SEED}"
    echo "=========================================="

    # Skip if already completed (eval + classify both done)
    if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/eval_results.json" ] && [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/classify.json" ]; then
        echo "[$(date -u)] SKIP: already completed"
        return 0
    fi

    mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"

    # Train (skip if checkpoint exists)
    if [ ! -f "${OUT_DIR}/config.json" ]; then
        $PYTHON scripts/train_grpo.py \
            --config ${CONFIG} \
            --data_path data/train_500_seed42.jsonl \
            --num_steps 500 \
            --seed ${SEED} \
            --beta 0.1 \
            --reward_mode ${REWARD_MODE} \
            --output_dir ${OUT_DIR} \
            --no_wandb \
            2>&1 | tee ${OUT_DIR}/train.log
        echo "[$(date -u)] Train done."
    else
        echo "[$(date -u)] Checkpoint exists, skip training."
    fi

    # Eval
    if [ ! -f "${OUT_DIR}/eval_results.json" ]; then
        $PYTHON scripts/eval_sta.py \
            --model_path ${OUT_DIR} \
            --data_path data/proofwriter_fol_100.jsonl \
            --output_path ${OUT_DIR}/eval_results.json \
            --solver prover9 \
            --max_samples 100 \
            2>&1 | tee ${OUT_DIR}/eval.log
        echo "[$(date -u)] Eval done."
    fi

    # Classify
    if [ ! -f "${OUT_DIR}/classify.json" ]; then
        $PYTHON scripts/classify_h7.py \
            --eval_path ${OUT_DIR}/eval_results.json \
            --json_out ${OUT_DIR}/classify.json \
            2>&1 | tee ${OUT_DIR}/classify.log
        echo "[$(date -u)] Classify done."
    fi

    # Cleanup model weights to save disk (~15GB per run)
    rm -f ${OUT_DIR}/model-*.safetensors
    rm -f ${OUT_DIR}/model.safetensors.index.json
    rm -f ${OUT_DIR}/optimizer*.bin ${OUT_DIR}/optimizer*.pt

set -eo pipefail

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

run_one() {
    local CONDITION=$1
    local SEED=$2
    local CONFIG
    local REWARD_MODE
    local OUT_DIR

    if [ "$CONDITION" = "isr" ]; then
        CONFIG="configs/grpo_additive_bonus_b01.yaml"
        REWARD_MODE="additive_bonus"
        OUT_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/d134_4b_isr_b01_s${SEED}"
    else
        CONFIG="configs/grpo_additive_random_b01.yaml"
        REWARD_MODE="additive_random"
        OUT_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/d134_4b_random_b01_s${SEED}"
    fi

    echo "=========================================="
    echo "[$(date -u)] START ${CONDITION} b=0.1 seed=${SEED}"
    echo "=========================================="

    # Skip if already completed (eval + classify both done)
    if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/eval_results.json" ] && [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/classify.json" ]; then
        echo "[$(date -u)] SKIP: already completed"
        return 0
    fi

    mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"

    # Train (skip if checkpoint exists)
    if [ ! -f "${OUT_DIR}/config.json" ]; then
        $PYTHON scripts/train_grpo.py \
            --config ${CONFIG} \
            --data_path data/train_500_seed42.jsonl \
            --num_steps 500 \
            --seed ${SEED} \
            --beta 0.1 \
            --reward_mode ${REWARD_MODE} \
            --output_dir ${OUT_DIR} \
            --no_wandb \
            2>&1 | tee ${OUT_DIR}/train.log
        echo "[$(date -u)] Train done."
    else
        echo "[$(date -u)] Checkpoint exists, skip training."
    fi

    # Eval
    if [ ! -f "${OUT_DIR}/eval_results.json" ]; then
        $PYTHON scripts/eval_sta.py \
            --model_path ${OUT_DIR} \
            --data_path data/proofwriter_fol_100.jsonl \
            --output_path ${OUT_DIR}/eval_results.json \
            --solver prover9 \
            --max_samples 100 \
            2>&1 | tee ${OUT_DIR}/eval.log
        echo "[$(date -u)] Eval done."
    fi

    # Classify
    if [ ! -f "${OUT_DIR}/classify.json" ]; then
        $PYTHON scripts/classify_h7.py \
            --eval_path ${OUT_DIR}/eval_results.json \
            --json_out ${OUT_DIR}/classify.json \
            2>&1 | tee ${OUT_DIR}/classify.log
        echo "[$(date -u)] Classify done."
    fi

    # Cleanup model weights to save disk (~15GB per run)
    if [ "$SEED" != "47" ]; then
        rm -f ${OUT_DIR}/model-*.safetensors
        rm -f ${OUT_DIR}/model.safetensors.index.json
        rm -f ${OUT_DIR}/optimizer*.bin ${OUT_DIR}/optimizer*.pt
        rm -f ${OUT_DIR}/training_args.bin
        rm -rf ${OUT_DIR}/global_step*
    else
        echo "[$(date -u)] PRESERVE: keeping weights for seed 47"
        rm -f ${OUT_DIR}/optimizer*.bin ${OUT_DIR}/optimizer*.pt
        rm -rf ${OUT_DIR}/global_step*
    fi

    echo "[$(date -u)] DONE ${CONDITION} b=0.1 seed=${SEED}"
    df -h /root/autodl-tmp | tail -1
    echo ""
}

echo "[$(date -u)] D134 PIPELINE START"
df -h /root/autodl-tmp

# ISR beta=0.1 seeds 47-51
for SEED in 47 48 49 50 51; do
    run_one "isr" $SEED
done

# Random beta=0.1 seeds 47-51
for SEED in 47 48 49 50 51; do
    run_one "random" $SEED
done

echo "=========================================="
echo "[$(date -u)] ALL 10 RUNS COMPLETE"
df -h /root/autodl-tmp
echo "=========================================="
